svg.aria-label: Dynamics 365 Business Central and customer engagement apps: operational data to Microsoft Fabric analytics
svg.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central and customer engagement apps: operational data to Microsoft Fabric analytics
svg.text: Dynamics 365 Business Central and customer engagement apps: operational data to Microsoft Fabric analytics

Customer engagement apps reach OneLake through Dataverse Link to Fabric (shortcuts); Business Central is replicated through an open mirrored database fed by an extract function; both land in one Fabric lakehouse for Power BI and a data agent

g.data-tip: An extract function reads changed Business Central records through the API v2.0 (filtered by last modified time) using a service principal

g.title: 1. An extract function reads changed Business Central records through the API v2.0 (filtered by last modified time) using a service principal

g.data-tip: The function writes initial and incremental change files to the open mirroring landing zone; Fabric applies them to Delta tables

g.title: 2. The function writes initial and incremental change files to the open mirroring landing zone; Fabric applies them to Delta tables

g.data-tip: Link to Microsoft Fabric creates a lakehouse with read-only shortcuts to Dataverse tables; data stays in Dataverse and refreshes within about an hour

g.title: 4. Link to Microsoft Fabric creates a lakehouse with read-only shortcuts to Dataverse tables; data stays in Dataverse and refreshes within about an hour

g.data-tip: Open mirrored database → Curated lakehouse (shortcut / SQL)

g.title: 5. Open mirrored database → Curated lakehouse (shortcut / SQL)
